annotations.title: Remote camping spots with signal near a place

description: Ranked camping spots near a point that are remote and still have signal for the carrier. Free: the top 3, with how many more the Camp Map Pass adds. With the pass: up to `limit`. access=rental keeps spots on pavement or under 500 m of unpaved road (most rental agreements exclude unpaved roads).

access.description: any; rental (on or near pavement); drive (paved or gravel); rough (rough or unpaved roads); hike (hike-in or boat access).

carrier.description: Mobile carrier to rank signal for. Canada: telus (also Bell, Koodo, Virgin), rogers (also Fido), freedom, sasktel. US: verizon, att, tmobile, gci, inland. Defaults to telus in Canada and verizon in the US.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative west of Greenwich.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (default 50, at most 200).

name: find_spots
